findings.location: #body, <body> element, page provides only one wayfinding mechanism, line 8
findings.evidence: #nav contains exactly 2 links (Plan a trip, Accessibility); no search form, sitemap link, breadcrumb trail, or related-links list appears anywhere else in the document
findings.violation: The page offers only one navigation mechanism, the primary navigation menu in #nav, and its content (rider service updates spanning station updates, schedule changes, and fare adjustments) does not mark it as one step in a linear process, so WCAG-2.4.5's requirement of at least two independent ways to locate this page is not met.
findings.fix: Add a second independent wayfinding mechanism, such as a site search form, a sitemap link, or a breadcrumb trail, so a reader who lands on this page directly still has more than one way to find related pages.
